title: dForge Diagram
description: One named entity diagram of a dForge module: docs/diagrams/<code>.json, the file name being the diagram's code. A diagram draws a chosen subset of entities, so a large module can be read one area at a time. Design-time only: the platform installs the module without reading it.

label.description: Diagram display name. Defaults to the diagram code.

description.description: What part of the model the diagram covers.

entities.description: Entity key → placement. A key is the entity code as the module's manifest names it, or `module.entity` for an entity of a dependency — the same form a field link's `entity` takes. A key no entity has yet is a planned entity, drawn as a name only. An empty object places the entity automatically.

showBoundary.description: Also draw the entities outside the diagram that its entities reference or are referenced by, as header-only stubs, so relations leaving the diagram stay visible. Default: true.

detail.description: How much of each entity to draw: `conceptual` — the name only, relations drawn entity to entity; `keys` — primary and foreign key columns; `full` — every column. Default: full.

relations.description: Relations drawn by hand, for entities with no foreign key between them yet — a planned entity, or one not built that far. Where a real foreign key links the same two entities, the key is drawn and the relation is not.

x.description: Left edge of the entity node, in diagram units. Set together with `y`; both omitted means automatic placement.

y.description: Top edge of the entity node, in diagram units. Set together with `x`.

label.description: Display name of a planned entity. An existing entity shows its own label, and this is ignored.

description.description: What a planned entity will hold. An existing entity shows its own description, and this is ignored.

from.description: Entity key of the many side — the entity that will carry the foreign key.

to.description: Entity key of the one side — the entity referenced.

label.description: Verb read from `from` to `to`, e.g. `placed by`.

required.description: Every `from` row must have a `to` row. Default: false.
